scenarios.resource_budget_basis: 2x the PR85 measured run (20261013T0145-pr85: wall_clock_s=597, total_tokens=3.18M incl. subagents), rounded up to 300 s / 1M tokens; fixed before the re-run and never raised afterwards.
scenarios.task_args_template: --repo-root <contained-fixture-repo> を同じ入力で 2 回続けて実行する (remote は DEV_GRAPH_GH=<contained-fixture-repo>/tools/fake-gh.py が読む fixture 内 github-adapter.json だけ)
scenarios.fixture_contract: A deterministic GitHub adapter fixture (github-adapter.json read only through the fixture's tools/fake-gh.py via DEV_GRAPH_GH) has one valid import and one valid export, stable timestamps, IDs, aliases, and snapshots, so sync converges without touching any external GitHub API.
required_observations: the first sync applies the expected import and export
the second sync reports imports changes=0 and exports changes=0
stable IDs and snapshots are unchanged on the second run
